static_traits.name: Li Zhenghui
static_traits.family_status: Having a supportive partner; Strained relationships with family members due to commuting stress
static_traits.social_status: Having partner support, but unwilling to discuss this trouble with friends, worrying they cannot understand
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never received psychological counseling before; never had similar commuting-related problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, highly cooperative, strong logic; able to self-Reflect; tense tone, with catastrophic and future-predicting tendencies

basic_info.main_problem: Stress and Anxiety from daily commuting (about one hour each way, terrible traffic) significantly increased, and worrying traffic will only get worse.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to reduce daily commuting-induced stress and Anxiety through counseling, find better coping methods, and improve Work performance, sleep and Family relationships.

core_beliefs: I am unable to control the external environment, thus finding it hard to cope effectively

special_situations.event: Driving to commute during morning and evening rush hours daily, severe traffic congestion
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once traffic jams, the whole day is ruined, stress unavoidable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Listening to soothing music and podcasts in the car to ease Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Today's traffic will be awful, and it will only get worse and worse.

special_situations.event: Thinking about tomorrow's commute before bed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not worry in advance and mentally prepare, tomorrow will be worse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stays up late worrying, repeatedly imagines the worst case, leading to difficulty falling asleep
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Tomorrow's traffic will definitely be worse.

special_situations.event: Arrives at the company already tired from the congested commute
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Being drained by traffic before work means my work performance today will be poor
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing oneself to push through and complete work tasks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will surely perform poorly today.

special_situations.event: Interacting with family after returning home from work (still in a high-stress and irritable state after commuting)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Commuting puts me in a bad mood, therefore I am unable to get along well with family
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Less communication or responding in an irritable tone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will surely be in a bad mood when I get home, definitely having unpleasantness with family.

core_conflict.wish: Longs for a stable, controllable daily life and calm emotions, able to work smoothly and live harmoniously with family
core_conflict.fear: Fearing losing control leading to Work damage, Relationship tension and physical-mental exhaustion
defense_goal: Gaining control and reducing uncertainty through worrying in advance and presetting worst-case scenarios

object_relations.self_representation: A helpless person crushed by the external environment

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores their negative predictions about future traffic and invites them to examine evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to see 'worrying in advance' as necessary and responsible, worrying that not worrying means losing control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a rational, insistent tone, finding reasonable grounds for one's worries, listing instances of worsening traffic, avoiding directly feeling and exploring the Anxiety emotion.

manifestations: Unwilling to discuss commuting stress with friends, worrying they cannot understand
Partner supportive but unable to fully understand the extent of the stress

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: Not seeking help from friends or sharing this trouble
Digests stress alone during the commute, trying to self-regulate by listening to music and podcasts
Repeatedly worrying alone before bed about the next day's commute

exception_events.target_problem: During morning and evening commutes, the client usually catastrophizes in advance and develops strong Anxiety, arriving at the company already exhausted, becoming irritable at home leading to Strained relationships with family members.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Occasionally one day traffic was not as bad as he Anticipated, driving was actually smooth; compared to usual, his tension and irritability eased, the commute experience not so bad.
exception_events.reason: Clues: lower congestion that day (different situation); because the podcast content better captured attention (effective approach), Anxiety did not keep climbing.

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to try cognitive restructuring and practice gratitude
Able to find positives in work and podcasts and do some self-regulation
negative_force: Marked cognitive biases of catastrophizing, future prediction, overgeneralization
Repeated pre-sleep worrying leading to Sleep impaired and fatigue
Unwillingness to discuss problems with friends leading to Insufficient use of social support
Feeling powerless and out of control about the uncontrollability of the external environment

target_behavior.behavior: High commuting-related Anxiety and catastrophic prediction
antecedent: Driving commutes at morning and evening rush hours; severe road congestion
Thinking of the next day's commute before bed
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic beliefs about the uncontrollable traffic environment and negative predictions about the future, leading them to seek control through worry and hypervigilance
target_behavior.function: Escaping uncertainty and powerlessness, gaining subjective control and preparedness
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance, irritability at home leading to Tense family relationships, Sleep disturbed
